name: semantic-crosscheck
description: Cross-layer verification for an ontology plus semantic layer on PostgreSQL 17, for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Prove that a PostgreSQL closure, SHACL rules, OWL reasoning and a Cube model agree.
interface.longDescription: Release v0.1.1: generates a PostgreSQL 17 hierarchy closure, SQL and SHACL data rules, an OWL ontology checked with HermiT and a Cube data model from one crosscheck.toml, then checks that the layers agree with each other and with hand-written gold SQL (strict compare, strata sweep, query shapes, mutation tests). Source data is only read, results carry counts and ids but never row values, and whatever a run cannot prove is reported as not_proven instead of passing.
defaultPrompt: Use semantic-crosscheck to run the synthetic demo end to end.
Use semantic-crosscheck to verify my crosscheck.toml against PostgreSQL and explain what is not proven.
